To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the c-fos and inducible c-AMP early repressor mRNAs are differentially expressed in response to lithium administration in rat forebrain.
LiCl administration rapidly stimulates expression of c-fos gene and later expression of ICER gene, a negative regulator of c-fos, in the CeA and the hypothalamic PVN and SON.
LiCl injection rapidly stimulates c-fos and later ICER mRNA expression and that ICER mRNA expression does not inhibit subsequent c-fos gene expression.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamics of c-fos gene activation in the rat brain following LiCl administration.
the time course of c-fos gene expression in the brain following lithium chloride injection in rats.
the timecourse of gene transcription following lithium chloride injection and its relevance to the mechanism of action of this agent.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

LiCl administration in the rat stimulates the expression of c-fos gene and later the expression of ICER mRNA in several forebrain nuclei, and that the time lag between the expression of c-Fos and ICER may reflect an inhibitory role for ICER in the termination of c-fos-mediated transcription.
the expression of ICER mRNA in the CeA and the PVN is induced by the LiCl injection, but the expression of IC ER in the SON may be induced by other factors.
ICER mRNA expression follows the timecourse of activation of c-fOS in the CeA and PVN, whereas in the SON, ICER expression precedes the timecourse of the c-fOS expression.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of c-fos gene is stimulated by LiCl injection and is followed later by the ICER gene expression, which is a negative modulator to terminate the c-fos transcription.
LiCl-induced c-fos expression in the CeA is followed by ICER expression, and that ICER may play a role in the termination of c-fos gene expression.
c-fos mRNA is transiently expressed in response to LiCl, and that ICER mRNA is expressed in a delayed manner to modulate this response.
The main takeaway from our work is that
c-fos mRNA is expressed in the brain following LiCl injection and that this expression is followed by ICER mRNA expression.

the c-fos and the ICER genes are activated in the brain following LiCl administration and that the timecourse of their expression is consistent with the ICER gene acting as a negative regulator of c-fos gene expression.

c-fos expression is a very sensitive marker for detecting changes in neuronal activity, and that the expression of ICER mRNA is a more specific indicator of the duration of LiCl-induced changes in cAMP-mediated gene expression.
